records.text: Ick is Krick’s minion, a massive undead creature pursued through the Pit of Saron. Its encounters include a toxic poison cloud and a chase that sends its target running.

Forgemaster Garfrost is a giant Scourge smith who speaks of himself in the third person. He boasts that he can improve his axe and freeze his opponents, treats mortals as food, and worries that the giant’s underpants will be clean so his boss is spared embarrassment. He serves a greater Scourge leader.
Rimefang is an undead creature.

An Alliance soldier captured and forced to work in the Pit of Saron quarry, this slave voices relief and gratitude when liberated. The captive offers a long night of drinking in thanks and urges vengeance on the Scourgelord.

An Alliance soldier captured and forced to work in the Pit of Saron quarry, this slave voices relief and gratitude when liberated. The captive offers a long night of drinking in thanks and urges vengeance on the Scourgelord.

An Alliance soldier captured and forced to work in the Pit of Saron quarry, this slave voices relief and gratitude when liberated. The captive offers a long night of drinking in thanks and urges vengeance on the Scourgelord.

An Alliance captive worked in the quarry, exhausted and nearly out of hope after losing track of time there. He speaks of too many deaths in the pit and asks that the Scourgelord face vengeance; his thanks to the one who frees him are mixed with a promise to repay the help.

One of the Horde soldiers captured and put to work in the quarry, this slave greets liberation with disbelief and gratitude. He raises a toast to his rescuer and calls for vengeance on the Scourgelord.
A Horde captive in the quarry, grateful to be freed, this slave offers a long night of drinking to a friend and asks that the Scourgelord face vengeance.
A Horde captive in the quarry, grateful to be freed, this slave offers a long night of drinking to a friend and asks that the Scourgelord face vengeance.
A Horde captive in the quarry, grateful to be freed, this slave offers a long night of drinking to a friend and asks that the Scourgelord face vengeance.
A necrolyte of the Cult of the Damned, identified as such in name and affiliation.

Scourgelord Tyrannus commands undead forces for the Lich King and guards the approach to his master's sanctum. He raises alarms when intruders enter, sends soldiers against pursuers, and threatens to turn them into mindless undead. His contemptuous taunts show confidence in the defenses under his command.
Wrathbone Laborers are undead workers in the Pit of Saron area of Icecrown Citadel. They can use Blinding Dirt in combat.
Fallen Warriors are undead combatants found in the Pit of Saron area of Icecrown Citadel. Their combat abilities include Arcing Slice.
A Disturbed Glacial Revenant is a glacial undead creature found in the Pit of Saron area. When engaged in combat, it can cast Avalanche.
Wrathbone Skeletons are skeletal undead found in the Pit of Saron area of Icecrown Citadel.
A Plagueborn Horror is a Scourge undead combatant whose attacks include Blight Bomb, Pustulant Flesh, and Toxic Waste.
A skeletal undead slave found in the Icecrown region.
A Geist Ambusher is a hostile undead creature. Its initial behavior is passive, suggesting it waits before engaging.
The rescued Alliance Slave points the way and announces an impending assault on the Scourgelord's location.
The rescued Horde Slave points the way and announces an impending assault on the Scourgelord's location.
An Iceborn proto-drake, this beast serves as a mount until combat begins, when it sheds its passenger.
A Stonespine Gargoyle is an undead combatant whose recorded attack is Gargoyle Strike.
An undead Wrathbone Siegesmith.

The Eye of the Lich King watches intruders and whispers that they should cry out in torment, surrender to pain, and release themselves from life's chains. Its words are meant to unsettle and break their resistance.

Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen, leads Horde forces against the Scourge and presses the assault forward. She is impatient with perceived incompetence, distrusts Krick, and remains intent on freeing captured soldiers and reaching the Lich King's chamber. Frostmourne's whereabouts matter to her as the objective draws near.

Jaina Proudmoore leads Alliance heroes against the Scourge. Arthas's betrayal still weighs on her: she blames herself for the soldiers lost to the Scourgelord and insists their sacrifice must not be wasted. Even in grief and anger, she urges her forces onward toward their objective.

Martin Victus is an Alliance commander in the Pit of Saron. He calls for captured soldiers to be freed and gathered into a force against Scourgelord Tyrannus. After the forgemaster falls, he urges his men to gear up for the next fight.

Gorkun Ironskull leads the Horde captives in the Pit of Saron. He calls on heroes to confront Scourgelord Tyrannus while his people hold off the undead. Grateful for their freedom, he promises to honor their deeds and praises Alliance and Horde cooperation.
A hungry ghoul found in the Pit of Saron, it uses Devour Flesh.
A Cult of the Damned shadowcaster in the Pit of Saron, it attacks with Shadow Bolt.
A Cult of the Damned torturer in the Pit of Saron, it attacks with Black Brand and Curse of Agony.
A Wrathbone Sorcerer is a spellcaster that attacks with Shadow Bolt.

Jaina Proudmoore leads her men in the push toward Scourgelord Tyrannus and the search for Frostmourne, which she hopes will provide answers for confronting Arthas. The losses weigh on her; she mourns those she could not save and remains determined to press on.

Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen, commands her men and Dark Rangers in the push toward Tyrannus and the search for Frostmourne, which she believes may hold answers for confronting Arthas. She treats her depleted forces as expendable, yet urges the champions onward and senses their objective is near.
